DIAGNOSIS READY: Compartment syndrome of the right ring finger.

The normal inflammatory markers and lack of systemic symptoms despite "pain out of proportion" strongly suggest a mechanical pressure issue rather than infection. Can you describe the sensation in your finger as tight, wooden, or numb?
